work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. CCXVIII 66250, synopsis 66252–66255, addressee 66257–66259 and Urbanus protocol 66261 follow previous dating 66240–66244. Preamble and sections 1–8 remain in order, with local notes 66282, 66335 and 66394 retained. Complete dating 66434–66437 plus marginal continuation 66440 precede CCXIX 66443. Two current notes appear after that next heading: 66450 corrects vestrum at 66426 to eorum, and 66452 corrects consequendum at 66431 to consignetur. Both are proved by exact word/marker context and retained separately, excluding the next act title and protocol.
